result.description: Web hosting and deployment platform: atomic deploys, forms, functions, DNS, env vars for sites and apps.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 for public integrations (auth-code flow); personal access token (Applications > Personal access tokens) sent as Authorization: Bearer for single-account use.
result.access_detail: Free plan ($0 forever) lists API deploys; PAT creation and OAuth app registration are self-serve in the UI. Docs do not state plan restrictions on PAT/API.
result.api_notes: REST at https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/ with OpenAPI spec (open-api.netlify.com). Covers sites, deploys, env vars, files, snippets, forms, hooks, DNS. Rate limit 500 req/min for most requests.

evidence.quote: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNS
Use your PAT for manual authentication in shell scripts or commands that use the Netlify API.
Deploy from AI, Git, or API
You can browse the OpenAPI reference for the Netlify API to explore available endpoints.
Netlify offers an MCP server, which you can connect to through a connector, plugin, or your agent.
